inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s call for a political resolution is important, but it sits uneasily beside a message still organized around Israel’s “unwavering stance” and an ongoing operation. That is the problem with treating military pressure as the center of security: it can perpetuate the very conditions that keep people across the region unsafe. A durable resolution has to confront the structures behind the conflict and protect people’s rights, not make endless escalation sound like the only option.
